test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: If cos27°=(P)/(q), then find the value of cosec 27° - cos 63°.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Convert to the same angle using complementary property: cos 63° = sin(90° − 27°) = sin 27°.

Simplify expression: cosec 27° − sin 27° = (1 − sin² 27°) / sin 27° = cos² 27° / sin 27°.

From given cos 27° = p / q, we find sin 27° = √(1 − p²/q²) = √(q² − p²) / q.

Substitute these values directly: (p / q)² ÷ [√(q² − p²) / q] = p² / [q√(q² − p²)].

**∴ The correct answer is p² / (q√(q² − p²)).**
